lines: We provide life-changing opportunities to young Indians of exceptional talent, character, and motivation. By seeking out and nurturing such talent, we aim for each personal achievement to benefit the individual and the wider world.

Since 1976, over 1400 talented young Indians have received, Scholarships, Awards, Fellowships, Art Residencies, Internships, and Grants across a wide range of subjects and endeavours, overseas and in India.
Our alumni reflect the diversity of individuals that we have supported over five decades. Today, many are leaders in their chosen fields.

Indoo Shivdasani (1918–1979), a successful entrepreneur, credited his Cambridge education with broadening his commercial and cultural horizons. He had a strong desire to give others a similar opportunity. A firm believer in the importance of overseas higher education for young Indians. He saw this as a way to foster their talent and develop their capacity to contribute to society.

Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation is completing 50 years in 2026.
To mark this milestone, several events are planned across the year to celebrate what lies at the core of the Foundation - its alumni.
The Foundation aims to provide crucial support to talented, passionate and committed dance artists, to pursue training at the Attakkalari Centre for Movement Arts, Bengaluru.

The Inlaks Residency at International Center of Photography, USA

The Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation in partnership with PhotoSouthAsia (PSA) and International Center of Photography (ICP) offers a 2 month residency to one emerging Indian photographic practitioner or researcher.
INTERSECTIONS: Sites of Becoming Draws to a Close

The milestone exhibition, held at Arthshila Delhi in celebration of the Foundation's fiftieth year, featured thought-provoking art by a cross-section of its alumni, and sparked important conversations on pressing issues in the art world today.
On 13th February 2026, the five Inlaks Fine Art Awardees for this year were felicitated at an event in Mumbai, in the presence of Inlaks alumni, members of the jury and guests from the art community.
50th Year Celebratory Lunch With Alumni and Friends of the Foundation, Delhi
Inlaks alumni across five decades and all opportunities joined friends and collaborators of the Foundation in celebrating its 50th anniversary on 8th February, 2026.
Milestone Alumni Art Exhibition INTERSECTIONS Opens in Delhi
The first of many events celebrating 50 years of the Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation, INTERSECTIONS: Sites of Becoming opened in Delhi on 7th February, 2026.
